versions.changelog:
Initial release of the 高空作业平台 (MEWP) workflow skill.

- Provides structured workflows for MEWP selection, engineering calculations, product information collection, and bidding tasks.
- Enforces data authenticity, citation of sources, and clear separation of calculation versus formal certification.
- Covers major industry standards (EN 280, GB/T 25849, ANSI A92) and mainstream brands (JLG, Genie, Haulotte, etc.).
- Integrates script-based tools for stability, wind load, motor, and hydraulic calculations.
- Supplies templates and guidelines for technical documentation, competitive analysis, and bid response preparation.
